name: Builder vs Live Parity
build_note: The provided ZIP does not contain tailwind.export.config.cjs, although package.json references it. A production npm export build could not be validated from this artifact; runtime/deployment QA should confirm the generated CSS bundle.
runtime_tests: Publish and compare 10 representative Sparks in Builder vs Live at desktop.
Repeat representative responsive checks at tablet and mobile.
Include Hero, Services, Cards/Grid, Media/Slider, Testimonials, Pricing, CTA, Process/Timeline, Gallery/Portfolio, and Contact/Form.
Verify theme, H1/H2 colors, radii, spacing, responsive typography, media crop, gradients, overlays, buttons, and interaction.
If any Spark differs, patch that renderer contract before declaring runtime parity.
